task: Resolve 'next is not a function' error when appointing defense panelists in FacultyCommitteeCard
trigger: User reported: I can't assign panels, if I add it pops-up 'next is not a function' /anti-slop
rootCause: In Mongoose 9.4.1, document pre-save middleware does not pass a callback 'next' function when executed by Kareem. In project.model.js line 856 and milestoneDeadline.model.js line 90, `pre('save', function (next) { ... next(); })` was still using legacy callback syntax, causing `next` to be undefined and throwing `TypeError: next is not a function` during `project.save()`.

verification.liveApiVerification: POST /api/projects/:id/panelists returned 200 OK with success: true and message 'Panelist assigned.'

lessonsLearned.lesson: Mongoose 9 document pre-save hooks must never declare or call `next()`. Modern Mongoose document middleware functions are synchronous or promise-returning.
lessonsLearned.prevention: Define all Mongoose document middleware as `function ()` or `async function ()` without `next` parameter.
lessonsLearned.runbook: When seeing `TypeError: next is not a function` during document operations, check schema `.pre('save', ...)` and `.pre('validate', ...)` definitions for callback-style `next` parameters.
